gap.title: One NOT gate saves nothing on 10 monotone functions of five inputs (shard 06 of 18), fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT lists
gap.statement: ∀ T ∈ ({0xe8a8a8a8, 0xe8a8e888, 0xe8e8e880, 0xeaa8a888, 0xeaa8c888, 0xeaa8e880, 0xeaaac880, 0xeac0e8c0, 0xeac8e0c0, 0xeac8e880} : Finset ℕ), ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) → (∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = Nat.testBit T (∑ i : Fin 5, if x i then 2 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0)) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o' : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length ∧ ∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', o'⟩ (List.ofFn x) = Nat.testBit T (∑ i : Fin 5, if x i then 2 ^ (i : ℕ) else 0)
gap.unlocks: One shard of the single-output question at 5 inputs: does one NOT gate save a gate on a single monotone output; a saving would show one output already pays for the NOT gate; size 30 to 60 minutes with a SAT solver.
gap.context: SKETCH: the shard; the route, the classes and the generator are in routes/lgp/own/filing/one-output-5/ (SKETCH.md); work from the row's own sentence. Namespace: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
